observation_model.one_row: one metric observation for one entity and year
observation_model.uncertainty: lower and upper bounds are optional and preserved when supplied
observation_model.provenance: every observation carries source_ids and source_record_id
observation_model.historical_years: BCE uses negative integers; CE uses positive integers

runtime: quantitative packs are lazy-loaded by source/domain/entity
scope_note: 1.2 establishes the numerical schema, source registry, ingestion contracts, validation, and runtime query layer. It does not fabricate precision where historical sources provide estimates or sparse observations.
